items.q: What did Dev Day add, on this telling?
items.a: Polish. He names **Soul 6.1**, **Ultra Fast**, **Dots**, and about **20 launches**, and says none of it felt new. It was less fraught than last year.

items.q: Why can the same plan suddenly buy less?
items.a: The tokens are **subsidized**. OpenAI and Anthropic are **losing money**. Paying true cost would make AI **less affordable**. He does not call a bubble about to pop.

items.q: What Anthropic figure does he relay?
items.a: Revenue up, and about a **$46 billion operating loss**. A **$6 trillion by 2030** data-center number does not scare him, because he treats most of it as **business, government, and military** spend.

items.q: Who does he think keeps the margin?
items.a: **Chip companies**, not token sellers. Selling tokens is **renting a GPU**. He names Nvidia, TSMC, ASML, Intel, Qualcomm, and AMD, and he **will not bet on implosion**.
